scope: Direct skin support for unchanged BG ColorPicker 1.0.1 via a skin-owned WindowXMLDialog override. No provider source or action arguments corrected.
finding: No skin-specific override existed. The addon fallback uses removed unqualified IsEmpty and StringCompare, and the earlier native run reports a 3110 focus error on each opening.
change: Provide supported skin controls, one shared palette grid, current Boolean expressions, optional/default heading binding, and initial focus on the existing manual-input button before onInit fills the panel. Keep provider input and return contract.

sources.finding: Same required control IDs, palette/data handling and colorstring property as the installed BG provider; skin override retains these IDs.
Requests script-skin_helper_service-ColorPicker.xml through WindowXMLDialog with the addon path as fallback.
onInit obtains panel 3110, fills it and chooses focus; buttons, slider and heading use the IDs recorded above.
Removal history names unqualified StringCompare and IsEmpty and their String namespace replacements; the new override uses supported expressions instead.

limits: Not every palette, input/navigation device, language or aspect ratio tested.
Initial unset color and caller-supplied optional heading are not runtime-tested.
The legacy provider fallback remains unchanged for other skins.
No claim that the previous focus error was specific to HorizonzV; it was also observed with Estuary.
